### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building Unity’s Android platform support across mobile, laptop, and hybrid devices. Optimizing runtime performance and enabling seamless game deployment.
Senior Software Engineer building Unity’s Android platform support for mobile, laptop, and hybrid devices
Role description:
• Design and develop features and workflows in the Unity Editor supporting specific Android platform configurations
• Profile, analyze, and identify optimization opportunities across the technology stack
• Collaborate cross-functionally to develop and implement runtime and platform optimization solutions
• Establish performance benchmarks and conduct rigorous Unity Engine performance analyses
• Author comprehensive technical documentation
• Participate actively in design review processes
• Investigate and resolve bug reports to ensure platform stability
• Improve quality and delivery through automated testing and thoughtful code reviews
• Foster innovation, teamwork, and technical excellence
Role requirements:
• Solid background in Android systems programming
• Advanced proficiency in C++, C#, and Java/Kotlin
• Experience building and maintaining platform or runtime systems
• Solid understanding of large applications spanning multiple languages, including synchronous/asynchronous calls, memory ownership, and marshalling
• Experience designing and implementing scalable feature sets in a large multithreaded codebase
• Strong diagnostic, debugging, and performance-profiling skills
• Familiarity with real-time 3D rendering methodologies and modern graphics APIs, including Vulkan
• Sufficient English proficiency for professional verbal and written communication
• Proven track record of writing high-quality software at scale
